title: Otomat
summary: Open a payment channel, lock tokens, and settle a payer-signed check through an Ed25519 pre-instruction.
what: Otomat is an Anchor 0.31.1 payment-channel rail. open_channel (seeds ["channel", payer, payee, mint]) funds an ATA owned by an escrow_auth PDA (seeds ["escrow_auth", channel]). close_channel, signed by the facilitator, settles a cumulative amount to the payee and refunds the rest, but only after instruction 0 is an Ed25519 verification of the payer's check: `otomat/v2/check|` || channel || cumulative_le || nonce_le || expiry_le.
app_note: The page at /dapps/otomat/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/otomat. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/otomat/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already opened a 2_000_000-token channel, rejected a close without Ed25519, then settled a 1_000_000 check.
try_steps.see: Program 343pmZcq…. Channel 3zfGyMqw… and escrow ATA 9GeU2hYH… should be closed; payee 4262h4DM… received 1_000_000.

diagram: payer --open_channel--> channel+escrow ATA; facilitator --close_channel + Ed25519(payer check)--> payee ATA + refund, accounts closed.
accounts: channel PDA seeds ["channel", payer, payee, mint]
innovation: Settlement is a facilitator-submitted, payer-signed off-chain check verified by the Ed25519 precompile; the program also checks that the pre-instruction's offsets point at its own data.
frontend: Generic IDL console at /dapps/otomat/. close_channel requires an Ed25519 pre-instruction as ix 0.
exercises: Reconstruct the check message for a 1_000_000 cumulative and nonce 1.
What error is returned if close_channel has no Ed25519 pre-instruction?
not_covered: Unilateral dispute, timeout reclaim, receipts, and facilitator bonds
